newsitem.title: USA: Comark to provide transmitters to Shockley.
newsitem.headline: Comark to provide transmitters to Shockley.

text.p: Thomson-CSF 's Comark Communications Inc said Friday it will provide TV transmitters and related services to Wisconsin-based Shockley Communications Corp.
Under the terms of the deal, Shockley will buy all its digital television and analog UHF transmitters and installation services from Comark.
Comark did not disclose expected revenues from the deal.
Shockley owns and operates television stations in Wausau, Eagle River, Lacrosse, Eau Claire and Madison. It is a privately-held company.
